
Hello and welcome to the LPC Revised collection!

This graphics pack was lovingly hand drawn, curated, and compiled by the tireless efforts of artists in the Creative Commons community, and by the volunteers at OpenGameArt.org. We're happy to support game developers with free, open content!

This pack is licensed OGA-BY 3.0. This means you can use these graphics free of charge, even for commercial use, so long as the artists are credited. I would also appreciate a link to this GitHub for future game devs!

These are all the artists who've contributed to this project:

	Eliza Wyatt (DeathsDarling)
	Lanea Zimmerman (Sharm)
	Stephen Challener (Redshrike)
	Johannes Sjölund (Wulax)
	BlueCarrot16
	BenCreating
	Durrani
	YuriNikolai
	Craftpix.net 2D Game Assets


If you only wish to use a small part of the LPC Revised kit, every spritesheet is accompanied by an entry in its local credits file.

Thank you for your time! If you'd like to support me, or see my other work, here's where you can find me:

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/DeathsDarling
Twitter: https://twitter.com/DeathsDarling
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/deathsdarlingart
Itch.io: https://deathsdarling.itch.io/
OpenGameArt.org: https://opengameart.org/users/deaths-darling

Files vendored for the Workspace Dashboard Office page (unmodified, renamed into a flat layout):
body/<tone>, head/<tone>     Characters/Body/Body 02 - Masculine, Thin; Characters/Head/Head 02 - Masculine
body-f/<tone>, head-f/<tone> Characters/Body/Body 01 - Feminine, Thin; Characters/Head/Head 01 - Feminine
head-old/<tone>              Characters/Head/Head 03 - Elderly
legs, feet, shirt/<colour>   Characters/Clothing/Masculine, Thin (Pants 03, Shoes 01, Shirt 04 - T-shirt)
legs-f, feet-f, shirt-f/<c>  Characters/Clothing/Feminine, Thin (same pieces)
hair/<style>/<colour>        Characters/Hair (Short 01-08, Medium 01-04 and 06-10, Facial Hair 03, 05, 06, 07)
hair-behind/<style>/<colour> The same styles' _Behind sheets
glasses/round, /halfmoon     Characters/Head Accessories/Eyewear 01 - Glasses, Eyewear 02 - Halfmoon Glasses
furniture, items, wall       Objects/Furniture, Objects/Small Items, Objects/Wall Items
                             (furniture/Fireplace.png is Objects/Furniture/Fireplace.png - Lanea Zimmerman (Sharm), Eliza Wyatt)
                             (items/Fireplace_Accessories.png is Objects/Small Items/Fireplace, Accessories A.png - Lanea Zimmerman (Sharm), Eliza Wyatt)
                             (items/Tabletop_Portraits.png is Objects/Small Items/Tabletop Portraits.png - Lanea Zimmerman (Sharm), Eliza Wyatt)
                             (items/Dessert.png is Objects/Small Items/Food/Dessert.png - BlueCarrot16, Eliza Wyatt)
                             (wall/Mailboxes.png is Objects/Wall Items/Mailboxes (tiling).png - Eliza Wyatt)
structure, floor, rugs       Structure/Walls (Painted Walls), Windows (Ornamental A), Doors (15 Panel A), Floor; Objects/Furniture/Rugs
seasonal/                    Objects/Furniture/Christmas Tree; Objects/Wall Items (Christmas Wall Decor, Pride Flags);
                             Objects/Small Items (Presents, Flowers, Skeletons A, Dungeon Elements, Food/Eggs, Food/Vegetables C)
